title.narrative: SERBIA SME COMPETITIVENESS SUPPORT Programme

description.narrative: The Serbia SME Competitiveness Support Programme (the Action or the Programme) proposed by the European Bank for Reconstruction (EBRD or the Organisation) aims to support small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) to improve their production capacities and enhance processes and product quality through the introduction of EU standards in the field of environmental protection, product safety, product quality and occupational health and safety.
